scientific_integrity: Direct independent parameter and Leibniz checks over small finite fields are included; small enumerations do not replace the all-field proof. A potentially relevant broad derivation-classification paper was not read in full, and priority remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: For all fields the derivation normal form is complete. Exact rank distributions are proved over even finite fields in all dimensions and odd finite fields only for the four-dimensional member. Not a classification of all nilpotent evolution algebras, conjugacy types, or the odd-characteristic higher-dimensional rank spectra. Absolute publication priority and independent validation are not established.
title: Characteristic-dependent complete derivation-rank spectra of a nilpotent evolution-algebra family
